user.title: Connect to Wyze
user.description: Enter the Wyze account credentials and API key used by the scales.

reconfigure.title: Update Wyze credentials
reconfigure.description: Enter the current Wyze account credentials and API key. Authentication is verified before the integration is updated.

error.cannot_connect: Could not authenticate with Wyze. Check the credentials and API key.

abort.already_configured: This Wyze account is already configured.

init.title: Sync and Garmin accounts
init.description: Choose how often to check Wyze for new measurements, or set the interval to 0 for manual-only syncing. Discovered profiles: {profiles}. Select a profile to configure its Garmin account. If Garmin requests MFA, enter the current code; it is not saved.

data.poll_interval_minutes: Poll interval in minutes (0 for manual only; otherwise 10-1440)

error.incomplete_garmin_account: Enter both a Garmin email and password for each account.
error.garmin_auth_failed: Garmin authentication failed. Check the account and MFA code.
